simple.meaning: שָׁאַר (shâʼar) appears 133 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 7:23. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, sacrifice, kingship, land, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁאַר (H7604) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שָׁאַר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: שָׁאַר (shâʼar) / H7604 is tracked through Genesis 7:23, Genesis 14:10, Genesis 32:9, Genesis 42:38. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
